notes_for_editor: The list gives elevation with no unit; the story reads it as feet.Only one 2016 list supports this record, and the list gives no register number for it. No source found for build date, status, access, staffing, height, design or photos, so none is set. The name is the list author's label, not a documented name. A Wikimedia Commons photo, 'Georgia Forestry Commission Tower, US 41 N, Tift County' (CC BY-SA 3.0), is captioned Tifton, but its camera location (31.488847, -83.518972) is about 7.5 km west of this record's coordinates, so it is not attached. The Savannah Now article is read from a Wayback Machine copy because the live site returned 403; statewide context only. The NHLR Georgia list (29 registered lookouts) does not name this tower.
